sentences: Ek pass mein hi sab elements compare ho jaate hain, isliye array sort ho gaya.
Loop sirf teen baar chalta hai aur swap se badi values aage chali jaati hain.
Har adjacent pair check kiya, toh chhoti value aage aur badi peeche set ho gayi.
Jab bhi a[j] bada mila, swap kar diya, isse pura array arrange ho gaya.
Loop khatam hone tak sab comparisons ho gaye, toh final array sorted mila.
